### Changed
- **Anthropic prompt caching is on for every Anthropic `ModelConfig` the platform renders; the kagent line moves to `v0.11.0-gs.15`** (giantswarm/giantswarm#37788). The kagent Go ADK sent every Anthropic request without `cache_control`, so each model call of an agent loop re-processed its whole prefix — system prompt, tool schemas, the growing history — at full input price, with a time to first token that followed the uncached prefix (gazelle, 2026-09-14: 0.7-1.5 s at 6 k input tokens, 9.7-13.5 s at 33-40 k; one twelve-call status question re-sent 340 k input tokens for $0.73). kagent `0.11.0-gs.15` carries kagent-dev/kagent#2788: `spec.anthropic.promptCaching` / `cacheTTL` on the ModelConfig CRD, three `cache_control` breakpoints in the Go ADK (the last tool definition, the last system block, the last content block of the latest turn), `cache_read_input_tokens` in the usage. The meta chart sets `kagent.providers.anthropic.config.promptCaching: true` and `cacheTTL: "5m"`, which the kagent chart renders into the default ModelConfig next to the LLM cut-over's `baseUrl`; the connectivity chart's `kagent.modelConfigs[]` Anthropic entries inherit both from that block (an entry's own `promptCaching` / `cacheTTL` win, `false` included; a Bedrock entry takes its own keys under `spec.bedrock`; any other provider refuses the keys naming the entry, and a `cacheTTL` outside `5m` / `1h` fails the render — the API server would prune or refuse them after the render said nothing). `components.kagent` / `components.kagent-crds` move to `>=0.11.0-gs.15 <0.11.1-0`: the floor, because an older CRD prunes the two fields at admission and the models stay uncached in silence. `make verify-prompt-caching` asserts the forwarding to both releases, the inheritance, the precedence, the Bedrock block, the chart-alone default and the guards; `tests/verify-kagent-crds.py` validates the cached shape against the gs.15 CRD; the BOM and `tests/verify-components.py` follow the pin. Lab proof (agentlab on 4.15.5 with the LLM listener on, the kagent controller and Go ADK built from the cherry-pick, `promptCaching: true` on the default ModelConfig, `claude-sonnet-4-6`, a five-call tool turn on a ~4.3 k-token prefix): stock gs.14 wrote and read nothing (five calls, $0.085); on the patch the first call wrote 4 302 tokens and every later call read 97-99 % of its prompt from the cache (the turn $0.037), and the next turn's first call read 3 961 tokens the previous turn had written ($0.019 for that turn); agentgateway's LLM listener passes `cache_control` through unchanged. **Every installation rolls kagent once** (the controller, then the platform Harness recompiles every admitted AgentTemplate) and its Anthropic ModelConfigs gain the two fields, which recompiles their templates again; from then on the first call of a turn writes the cache (1.25×) and every call after reads it (0.1×) — UPGRADE.md, including the opt-out.
